pages.content: About Bengali Association of Aerospace Park | North Bangalore ✦ Today 🪔 Next Event: Durga Puja 2026 · Aerospace Park, Bengaluru 🪔 Next Event: Durga Puja 2026 · Aerospace Park, Bengaluru Reg. No: DRB1/SOR/220/2025-2026 Celebrate the Grandeur of Bengali Festivities Stand out, Being you! 𝑨𝑰 𝑪𝒉𝒂𝒕𝒃𝒐𝒕 𝑨𝒔𝒌 𝑨𝒏𝒚𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒏𝒈! We, the Bengali community in and around Aerospace Park, North Bangalore, warmly welcome you. This platform serves as a living archive-honouring cherished Bengali traditions, vibrant cultural expressions, and the spirit of communal harmony. Across continents and cultures, these festivities becomes the thread that binds Bengalis everywhere. From distant lands to familiar neighbourhoods, it is the time we gather-not just as individuals, but as one global community. Rooted in deep respect for our heritage and with heartfelt gratitude to all our visitors, this site aspires to illuminate the splendour and sanctity of these sacred festivities. Thank you for joining us and celebrating the spirit that unites us all. Durga Puja Kojagori Lakshmi Puja Noboborsho Poila boishak Family Day Outing দোল উৎসব ২০২৬ Holi 2026 স্বাগতম! “বাঙালিয়ানার আড়ম্বর উৎসবে মেতে উঠুন” নিজস্বতায় দীপ্ত হোন, হোন অনন্য এক পরিচয় ! আমরা, উত্তর বেঙ্গালুরুর এয়ারোস্পেস পার্ক ও তার আশেপাশের বাঙালি সমাজ, আপনাদের আন্তরিকভাবে আমন্ত্রণ জানাই। এই প্ল্যাটফর্মটি একটি জীবন্ত আর্কাইভ হিসেবে কাজ করে—যেখানে প্রিয় বাঙালি ঐতিহ্য, প্রাণবন্ত সাংস্কৃতিক অভিব্যক্��ি এবং সাম্প্রদায়িক সম্প্রীতির চেতনার প্রতি শ্রদ্ধা জানানো হয়। বিশ্বের নানা প্রান্তে, নানা সংস্কৃতির মাঝে, এই উৎসবগুলোই বাঙালিদের এক অদৃশ্য বন্ধনে যুক্ত করে রাখে। দূরদেশে হোক বা চেনা পাড়ায়—এই সময় আমরা একত্রিত হই, শুধু ব্যক্তি হিসেবে নয়, এক বিশ্বব্যাপী বাঙালি পরিবার হিসেবে। আমাদের ঐতিহ্যের প্রতি গভীর শ্রদ্ধা এবং সকল দর্শনার্থীর প্রতি আন্তরিক কৃতজ্ঞতা নিয়ে, এই সাইটটি এই পবিত্র উৎসবগুলির জৌলুস ও পবিত্রতাকে উজ্জ্বল করে তোলার প্রয়াস। আমাদের সঙ্গে যুক্ত থাকার জন্য এবং এই একতাবদ্ধতার চেতনাকে উদ্‌যাপন করার জন্য ধন্যবাদ। 🤝 Become a Member " Heralding the Celebration to Come" - "আসন্ন উৎসবের বার্তা বাহক" Durga Puja 2026 দুর্গোৎসব ২০২৬ Click on the above image Durga Puja 2026 Cultural Events 2026 Durga Puja Sponsors Click on the above image About · Bengali Association of Aerospace Park · Est. 2025 About Us Bengali Association of Aerospace Park (BAAP) — a registered cultural society celebrating Bengali heritage in North Bangalore. 01 · Who We Are The Bengali Association of Aerospace Park (BAAP) is a registered cultural society representing the Bengali community in and around Aerospace Park, North Bangalore, Karnataka. Registration: DRB1/SOR/220/2025-2026 Act: Karnataka Societies Registration Act, 1960 Type: Registered Cultural Society Location: Aerospace Park, Bagalur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 562149 Website: aerospaceparkbengalis.in 02 · Our Mission "To celebrate, preserve, and promote Bengali cultural heritage in North Bangalore — bringing together families, children, and the wider community through joyful, inclusive, and grand celebrations across the year." — Celebrate the Grandeur of Bengali Festivities · Stand Out, Being You! 03 · What We Do We organise cultural events and festivities throughout the year for the Bengali community in and around Aerospace Park, Bagalur, Devanahalli, and North Bengaluru. Our annual Durgotsav 2026 celebrations are coming in October — read more here . 04 · Our Achievements 🏆 Aerospace Park, North Bangalore's First Grand Durgotsav Hosted the first ever Durga Puja at Aerospace Park in 2025 — a historic moment for the fast-growing North Bangalore community. 🌐 GDPDI Score 78 · Outstanding · Global #13 · India #6 · AI Rank #1 Ranked Outstanding in the Global Durga Puja Digital Index (GDPDI) Edition 4 — the world's first ranking of 256 Durga Puja association websites across 41 countries. Score 78/100 places BAAP in the top tier globally. Read full story → 🤖 AI-Powered Community Chatbot · AI Rank #1 Globally Ranked AI #1 globally in GDPDI — one of the first Durga Puja associations worldwide to deploy an AI-powered RAG chatbot for community engagement. 05 · Our Community We are a community of Bengali families living across the rapidly growing residential neighbourhoods of North Bengaluru — united by our shared love for Bengali culture, traditions, and festivities. pages.title: Ai Chatbot
pages.content: AI Chatbot for Durga Puja & Bengali Events | Bengali Association Aerospace Park Bangalore Bengali Association of Aerospace Park | North Bangalore Skip to content . AI Chatbot for Durga Puja & Bengali Events | Bengali Association Aerospace Park Bangalore 7th April 2026 Meet the AI Chatbot on Our Website Bengali Association of Aerospace Park now has a live AI chatbot, accessible directly from the top navigation of our website. No app to download. No form to fill. Just ask, and it answers. Try it now → Open the AI Chatbot — also linked from the main menu above. What Can You Ask It? Think of it as a knowledgeable friend who knows everything about our association and is available around the clock. Some things you might ask: When is the next Durga Puja? What should I expect? How do I get in touch with the association? Where are you on social media? How do I become a member? What is the fee? What events have already happened this year? What activities are there for kids? It will respond directly — no redirecting you to another page, no vague answers. If it knows, it tells you. If it does not know, it says so honestly. Ask in English or Bengali — Your Choice The chatbot is fully bilingual. Use the toggle at the top of the chatbot to switch between English and Bengali (বাংলা). Type your question in either language and receive a response in the same language — including Bengali script. Prefer to speak rather than type? There is a microphone button. Speak your question aloud in English or Bengali, and the chatbot will listen, understand, and reply. The response can also be read aloud to you at the touch of a button. The chatbot understands natural, conversational language. You do not need to use special keywords or commands — just ask the way you would ask a person. What It Knows — and What It Does Not The chatbot is built entirely around the content of our own website. It knows our events, our history, our contacts, our social media, and our community activities. It does not browse the internet, search for restaurants, give directions, or answer anything outside the scope of our association. This is intentional. A focused assistant gives more accurate, more relevant answers than a general one. You are talking to someone who knows our community deeply, not a search engine. How It Works — in Plain Language Without going into technical detail, here is the simple version: It reads our website. All content from our website is collected and kept as a structured knowledge base that the chatbot draws from. It finds what is relevant. When you ask a question, it identifies which parts of that knowledge are most relevant to what you asked. It generates a response. An AI language model reads the relevant content and writes a clear, conversational answer — in your chosen language. It stays honest. The response is always grounded in actual content from our website. It does not invent information. It is secure. Your conversation is not stored. The system is built with standard security practices so that no sensitive credentials are ever visible on your screen. This approach — retrieving relevant knowledge before generating a response — is what researchers and practitioners call Retrieval-Augmented Generation . The associations chatbot uses this pattern to stay accurate and to the point. At a Glance Feature What It Means for You Ask anything, anytime No wait, no office hours — instant answers about the association English and Bengali Switch languages freely, including voice in both Voice input and output Speak your question and listen to the answer hands-free Grounded in our content Every answer comes from what we have actually published — nothing made up No app needed Works in any browser on phone or desktop — nothing to install Privacy-first No conversation history stored, no data retained A Note on Authorship This chatbot was independently designed and developed by an individual member of our association as a personal contribution to the community. We are genuinely grateful for this initiative and are happy to feature it on our platform. The association warmly acknowledges the effort — and equally, the code, its architecture, and its ongoing upkeep belong entirely to the individual who built it. The association does not hold responsibility for the technical implementation or operation of the chatbot. The content of this post has been written by the same individual. It reflects their own perspective and understanding of the work. We share it here in the spirit of community and transparency, and thank the author for both the chatbot and the explanation. Technical questions about how it works are best directed to the author rather than to the association. pages.title: Baap Gdpdi Ranking Global Durga Puja Digital Index
pages.content: BAAP Ranked in Global Durga Puja Digital Index (GDPDI) — Worlds First Durga Puja Website Rankings Bengali Association of Aerospace Park | North Bangalore Skip to content . BAAP Ranked in Global Durga Puja Digital Index (GDPDI) — Worlds First Durga Puja Website Rankings 7th April 2026 Research & Recognition · March 2026 · Outstanding Score As a member of the Bengali Association of Aerospace Park (BAAP) , I found out that our associations website had been independently evaluated and ranked in a global research index called the Global Durga Puja Digital Index (GDPDI) . It has also given the scope of improvements, from which we implemented few. I felt this deserved a proper write-up, not just because BAAP features in it, but because the index itself is a remarkable piece of independent research that the Bengali community worldwide should know about. What is the Global Durga Puja Digital Index (GDPDI)? The Global Durga Puja Digital Index — commonly referred to as GDPDI — is the worlds first independent research index that systematically evaluates and ranks Durga Puja association websites from across the globe. As of Edition 4 (March 2026), the index covers 256 associations across 41 countries and 6 continents . The index is published under GDPDI Independent Research and is not affiliated with any employer, government body, or commercial organisation. It is entirely open-access and based on publicly verifiable international frameworks including: W3C WCAG 2.2 — Web Accessibility Guidelines Nielsen Norman Group — 10 Usability Heuristics Google Core Web Vitals — Performance Standards W3C Web Internationalisation — Multilingual Standards Gartner Digital Experience Platform 2024 Google AI Principles — AI Adoption Criteria W3C Web Trust Framework — Credibility Standards Every association is evaluated across 11 distinct digital criteria and awarded a score out of 100. The GDPDI is the only index of its kind — there is no comparable global ranking system for Durga Puja associations anywhere in the world. 🔗 Explore the full index: gdpdi.github.io/gdpdi How Does GDPDI Score an Association? Each associations website — not the association itself — is evaluated. The score reflects digital maturity, not the scale or grandeur of the puja celebration. A small association with an excellent website can outrank a famous one with a poor digital presence. ≥ 78 Outstanding ⭐ 62 – 77 Good < 62 Developing Where Does BAAP Stand in GDPDI Edition 4? In GDPDI Edition 4 (March 2026), the Bengali Association of Aerospace Park was evaluated and ranked as follows: GDPDI · March 2026 · Edition 4 · Outstanding Bengali Association of Aerospace Park (BAAP) 78 / 100 points OUTSTANDING 🌐 Global #13 Asia #7 India #6 Karnataka #5 🤖 AI Rank #1 A score of 78/100 places BAAP in the Outstanding band — the highest tier in the GDPDI scoring framework, reserved for scores of 78 and above. To be ranked 13th globally out of 256 associations across 41 countries — for an association that completed its very first Durga Puja in 2025 — is a remarkable achievement. Notably, BAAP holds AI Rank #1 globally in the index — the highest AI adoption score among all 256 associations evaluated — reflecting the associations investment in its AI-powered chatbot at ragaichatbot.github.io/aichatbot , which allows visitors to ask questions about the association and Bengali festivities. Why Does This Matter for the Bengali Community? The GDPDI is significant beyond just rankings. It is the first attempt to systematically document and evaluate the digital presence of Durga Puja associations worldwide . For Bengalis in the diaspora — across the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, Europe, and Southeast Asia — Durga Puja associations are lifelines of cultural identity. The index reveals how associations are investing in digital infrastructure to reach their communities, welcome new members, and preserve Bengali cultural heritage online. It also highlights a growing trend: associations that adopt AI, multilingual content, and accessible web design are the ones building lasting digital communities. What Can Associations Do to Improve Their GDPDI Score? The GDPDI full research report (available for download at gdpdi.github.io/gdpdi ) contains individual scorecards for every association with specific recommendations. Generally, associations can improve by: Publishing bilingual content — Bengali and English Maintaining a regularly updated website with event information Embedding structured data and proper SEO metadata Ensuring mobile responsiveness and fast page loading Adopting AI tools for community engagement Making contact and membership information easily accessible Adding accessibility features for differently-abled visitors Publishing Privacy Policy and legal pages Explore the Full GDPDI Index The complete GDPDI rankings — including all 256 associations, their scores, country-wise and continent-wise rankings, and the full downloadable research report — are freely available at: 🔗 gdpdi.github.io/gdpdi Free · Open Access · No login required A Animesh Mondal Member, Bengali Association of Aerospace Park (BAAP) · North Bangalore AI enthusiast and technology practitioner with a keen interest in Bengali cultural community infrastructure and digital innovation. Legal · Last Updated: March 2026 Privacy Policy Bengali Association of Aerospace Park (BAAP) · aerospaceparkbengalis.in The Bengali Association of Aerospace Park (BAAP) is committed to protecting the privacy of all visitors to this website. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights. 01 · Who We Are Organisation: Bengali Association of Aerospace Park (BAAP) Registration: DRB1/SOR/220/2025-2026 · Karnataka Societies Registration Act, 1960 Website: aerospaceparkbengalis.in Email: bengaliassnaerospacepark@gmail.com · aerospaceparkbengalis@gmail.com Location: Aerospace Park, Bagalur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 562149, India 02 · What Information We Collect We collect personal information only when you voluntarily provide it through our website forms: Membership Request — Name, email, mobile, apartment/location Event Registration — Name, email, mobile, age, event preference Sponsorship Enquiry — Name, organisation, email, mobile, sponsorship details We do NOT collect payment information directly. All payments are handled offline or through third-party channels. 03 · How We Use Your Information Information you provide is used solely for: Processing membership requests and event registrations Communicating event details, updates and announcements Responding to sponsorship enquiries Maintaining association records We do not use your information for automated decision-making or profiling. 04 · Do We Share Your Information? No. BAAP does not sell, trade, rent or share your personal information with any third party, advertiser or commercial organisation. Your information may only be accessed by BAAP committee members for processing your request. 05 · Cookies & Tracking To provide a seamless browsing experience, we use a minimal cookie management system. These cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences. Essential Cookies: Required for site security and core functionality. Functional Cookies: Remembers your interactions (like closing the banner). Analytics: Anonymous visitor counts via WordPress.com (No personal ID). Control: You can accept or reject non-essential cookies via our floating banner. You may also clear your browser cache at any time to remove stored cookies. 06 · Third-Party Links This website contains links to Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Google Maps and GitHub Pages. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external sites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies separately. 07 · Data Retention We retain information submitted through our forms for the duration of the membership year or event, after which it is deleted or anonymised. 08 · Your Rights You have the right to: Access your data Correct inaccuracies Request deletion To exercise any of these rights, email us at bengaliassnaerospacepark@gmail.com and aerospaceparkbengalis@gmail.com 09 · Childrens Privacy Our website and events welcome families and children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without parental consent. Event registrations for minors must be submitted by a parent or guardian. 10 · India Data Protection (DPDP Act 2023) This website complies with Indias Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) . As a Data Fiduciary, BAAP processes personal data only for lawful purposes and with your consent. Lawful Processing: Data is collected only with your explicit consent via our forms. Purpose Limitation: Data is used only for the purpose stated at the time of collection. Data Principal Rights: You have the right to access, correct, and request erasure of your personal data at any time. Grievance Redressal: All data-related grievances may be submitted via email to bengaliassnaerospacepark@gmail.com and aerospaceparkbengalis@gmail.com . All grievances will be addressed within 30 days of receipt as required under the Act. To exercise your rights under the DPDP Act, email us at bengaliassnaerospacepark@gmail.com and aerospaceparkbengalis@gmail.com 11 · Changes to This Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The Last Updated date at the top reflects any changes. Continued use of the website after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy. Questions or Concerns? pages.content: Durga Puja 2026 / Durgotsav 2026 – North Bangalore Bengali Association of Aerospace Park | North Bangalore Skip to content . Durga Puja 2026 / Durgotsav 2026 – North Bangalore 6th October 2026 Durga Puja 2026 Bangalore | Durgotsav at Aerospace Park, Bagalur, North Bangalore | BAAP Bengali Association of Aerospace Park • North Bangalore Durgotsav 2026 দুর্গোৎসব ২০২৬ Grand Five-Day Durga Puja Celebration at Shri Mahaganapathi Shaneshwara Swamy Anjaneya Swamy and Navagraha Temple.KIADB Aerospace Park. Bagalur. 🗓️ October 16 – 21, 2026 | Mahalaya: October 10 🗓️ Festival Dates Oct 16–21, 2026 Venue 📍 https://maps.app.goo.gl/eahgd6ik2HnTJmGL6?g_st=ac Shri Mahaganapathi Shaneshwara Swamy Anjaneya Swamy and Navagraha Temple.KIADB Aerospace Park, Bagalur. 🏅 Best Experience BAAP Members 🤝 Visitors All Welcome মা আসছেন — Maa Aashchen! The Bengali community of KIADB Aerospace Park, Bagalur, North Bangalore invites you to the grandest cultural celebration of the year — Durgotsav 2026 , organised by the Bengali Association of Aerospace Park (BAAP) . For five magnificent days this October, the spirit of Bengal comes alive at the heart of North Bangalores fastest-growing township. Whether you are searching for Durga Puja near me in Bangalore , the best Durga Puja in North Bangalore, or a Bengali puja celebration close to Yelahanka, Hebbal, Devanahalli, or Jakkur — BAAP Durgotsav is your destination. Come as a devotee, come as a culture lover, come as a neighbour. All are welcome. 🌙 Mahalaya 2026 — October 10 (Saturday) The sacred dawn of Devi Paksha begins. Listen to Chandi Path, perform Tarpan, and welcome the journey of Goddess Durga from Kailash to Earth. BAAP members celebrate Mahalaya together — details to be announced on our Social Media Platforms. About BAAP — Who We Are The Bengali Association of Aerospace Park (BAAP) is a registered cultural society serving the growing Bengali community at KIADB Aerospace Park Township, Bagalur, North Bangalore — PIN 562149. Comprising families from across West Bengal and the Bengali diaspora, BAAP has been celebrating the full calendar of Bengali festivals including Durga Puja, Holi (Dol Utsav), and Kojagori Lakshmi Puja. BAAP is also recognised as the AI Rank #1 Bengali association globally in the Global Durga Puja Digital Index (GDPDI) Edition 4 — the only Bengali association in the world with an AI-powered RAG chatbot on its website, answering community queries 24×7 in both English and Bengali. 🌐 Official Website: www.aerospaceparkbengalis.in Durga Puja Near You — North Bangalore Coverage BAAP Durgotsav is the closest and most accessible Durga Puja for residents across North Bangalore and the NH-44 corridor. If you are searching for: Durga Puja Aerospace Park Durga Puja Bagalur Durga Puja North Bangalore Durga Puja Yelahanka Durga Puja Hebbal Durga Puja Devanahalli Durga Puja Jakkur Durga Puja Thanisandra Durga Puja Kogilu Durga Puja Kannur Durga Puja near airport Bangalore Bengali Puja North Bangalore Durga Puja near me Bangalore Best Durga Puja Bangalore 2026 BAAPs location at KIADB Aerospace Park, Bagalur places it uniquely on NH-44 (Old Bellary Road), making it easily reachable from Yelahanka (15 min), Hebbal (25 min), Devanahalli (20 min), Jakkur (20 min), and Thanisandra (30 min). It is also the nearest prominent Durga Puja for residents of Aerospace Park township, Bagalur village, Kannur, Kogilu Cross, and the entire KIADB industrial corridor. 📍 Venue & How to Reach KIADB Aerospace Park Community Area, Bagalur, Bangalore — 562149 On NH-44 (Bellary Road), approximately 35 km from Majestic, 25 km from Hebbal flyover From Hebbal / Mekhri Circle: Take NH-44 North towards Devanahalli. Cross Yelahanka, continue to KIADB Aerospace Park gate. ~25 km, 30–40 mins. From Yelahanka: Continue on NH-44 North past Air Force Station. KIADB Aerospace Park is ~10 km from Yelahanka junction. ~15 mins. From Devanahalli / Airport: Take NH-44 South towards Bangalore. KIADB Aerospace Park is approximately 15 km from Devanahalli town. ~20 mins. From Jakkur / Thanisandra: Take Thanisandra–Bagalur Road or Jakkur–Yelahanka road connecting to NH-44. By BMTC: Routes serving Yelahanka connect to Bagalur area. Auto/cab from Yelahanka bus stand recommended for last mile. 📍 Open in Google Maps What to Expect at BAAP Durgotsav 2026 BAAP Durgotsav is a community celebration that blends deep-rooted Bengali tradition with warmth and inclusivity. Here is what makes it special: 🙏 Traditional Puja Rituals Complete Shashthi to Dashami rituals conducted by experienced pandits following authentic Bengali tradition. Pushpanjali sessions on Saptami, Ashtami, and Navami open to all devotees. Sandhi Puja at the exact transition between Ashtami and Navami — the most sacred 48-minute window of the entire festival. 🥁 Dhak, Dhunuchi & Dance The unmistakable sound of Dhak drums fills the air throughout the celebration. Dhunuchi dance — the beloved coconut-shell incense ritual — on Ashtami and Navami evenings. Cultural performances including Rabindra Sangeet, folk dance, and community presentations. 🍚 Bhog Prasad Traditional Khichudi Bhog on Ashtami — prepared with devotion and served to all attendees. The authentic taste of Bengals festival food, made with love by our community members. 👘 Sindoor Khela on Dashami The most emotional moment of Durga Puja — married women bid farewell to Maa Durga with Sindoor Khela (Devi Baran) before the Bisarjan procession. A celebration of womanhood, community, and love. Experience Durgotsav the Way It Was Meant to Be There is attending a Durga Puja — and then there is being part of one. Visitors witness the celebration. BAAP members are woven into its very soul. Every dhak beat that fills the air during Durgotsav, every marigold garland that adorns the pandal, every grain of rice in the Bhog — it all comes together because BAAP members give months of their heart, effort, and devotion to make it happen. Membership is not a card or a formality. It is an identity. It is the quiet pride of knowing that this celebration exists, in part, because of you . ✦ The Privilege of Belonging — What BAAP Members Live As a BAAP member, you are invited into the innermost circle of Durgotsav. You step into the sacred space of the puja rituals — offering anjali, participating in the Pushpanjali as a devotee of the house, not a visitor at the gate. You are present at the Sandhi Puja as one of the family, standing at the threshold of that luminous 48-minute passage between Ashtami and Navami. On Dashami, you take part in Sindoor Khela not as a spectator but as someone who has earned the right to bid farewell to Maa alongside those who called her here. Beyond the rituals, members are drawn into the cultural life of Durgotsav — the performances, the rehearsals, the late evenings of preparation that nobody photographs but everyone remembers. This is the texture of belonging that no ticket, no gate pass, and no casual visit can ever offer. 🙏 Serve as a Sevak — Walk Alongside the Devotees One of the most quietly honoured roles in BAAP Durgotsav is that of the committee sevak — members who serve as guides and companions to the darsharnarthis, the devotees who come seeking Maas blessings. To help an elderly grandmother find her way to the anjali queue, to gently explain the significance of Sandhi Puja to a first-time visitor, to ensure every soul who enters the pandal feels welcome and cared for — this is seva in its truest form. BAAP members do not merely attend the festival. They hold it for everyone who walks through the door. 🤝 Neighbours and Guests Are Always Welcome BAAP warmly welcomes neighbours, colleagues, and friends from all communities. All five days of Durgotsav are open. But if the festival stirs something in you — if you leave and find yourself already thinking of next year — then perhaps what you are feeling is not just appreciation. Perhaps it is the beginning of belonging. Become a BAAP Member → Frequently Asked Questions W
